title: Today’s feel: headache threshold lower.
caption: Today’s feel: headache threshold lower. Space weather is loud today—faster solar wind and a south-leaning field are giving Earth a stronger nudge, so focus and energy may swing and some heads may grumble. Use 5–10 min slow breathing to settle spikes, and work in small blocks with quick off-screen pauses.
snapshot: Geomagnetic activity is running higher than the last couple of days. The solar wind is moving faster, and the magnetic field has leaned south at times, which tends to couple more strongly with Earth. No notable solar flares. A recent CME was observed, but it’s background context only right now.
affects: Focus and energy may swing, with shorter clear stretches and a bit more restlessness for some. Headache‑ and migraine‑prone folks could feel a lower threshold. Mood and patience can feel thinner when the background is this active. Quiet conditions earlier this week don’t erase carryover if your week has been full—pace for what’s in your body today.

fb.caption:
Today’s feel: headache threshold lower. Because the solar wind is running faster and Earth’s magnetic field has been tilting south here and there, the background push is louder, so focus and energy can wobble and some people may feel closer to a headache edge.

If your patience is thin or your head feels touchy, treat the day like it has sharper corners. Try one simple anchor: 6–8 minutes of slow, easy breathing when you notice a spike, then work in a short, defined window and step away for a quick off‑screen reset—roll your shoulders, relax your jaw, and get a bit of daylight if you can. Hydrate and keep caffeine earlier so you’re not stacking stimulants on a jumpy backdrop, and peek at local pressure, storms, smoke, or allergens since they can add their own layer. Quiet earlier in the week doesn’t cancel what your body is carrying; pace for what’s true today.
